The Employer Nomination Scheme subclass 186 Direct Entry stream and the Skilled Employer Sponsored Regional visa subclass 494 can both process in as fast as 2 to 4 months for priority occupations. Germany's work visa is employer led. Your employer applies for your work permit once you have a confirmed offer. You do not file separately. The employer's willingness to sponsor is the key variable, not a complex government sponsorship system. 💼

Step one: identify your occupation on Germany's shortage list. IT, engineering, healthcare, skilled trades, and data science are the highest approval rate categories. Step two: build a Germany-ready CV in European format, one to two pages, no photo unless specified, achievement focused. Step three: target employers actively hiring internationally. SAP, Siemens, Bosch, Bayer, BMW, hospital networks, and Mittelstand engineering companies are all active sponsors. Step four: apply, interview, receive offer.
